class.name: ScriptDiagnosticCaptureResult
class.brief_description: Return value and captured diagnostics from [method ScriptDiagnosticCaptureScope.capture] or [method ScriptDiagnosticCaptureScope.capture_async].
class.description: Produced when a scoped capture helper finishes running a callable. [member return_value] is [code]null[/code] when the callable ended via runtime error. [member capture] is the stopped capture containing every recorded event.

members.member: The stopped capture with all recorded diagnostic events.
The callable's return value, or [code]null[/code] when the callable ended via runtime error.
